name: unity
description: Drive Unity with your AI coding agent via unity-mcp-cli: create a project, install the plugin, log in, and open the editor connected to ai-game.dev — automatically.

interface.shortDescription: Create, connect & build Unity games with AI via ai-game.dev.
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex to drive Unity end to end through the unity-mcp-cli npm package: scaffold a project via Unity Hub, install the Unity-MCP package, log in to ai-game.dev, open the editor (which auto-connects in Cloud mode), confirm the connection, and wire the project's MCP tools — so you can build a Unity game just by asking.
defaultPrompt: Set up a new Unity game with AI and connect it to ai-game.dev.
Open my Unity project with AI and wire up the MCP tools.
